Start: {start}. Stopp: {stop}. Push-to-T: Start: {start}. Stop: {stop}. Hold-to-transcribe: {push}. Identical start/stop keys toggle recording. Hold-to-transcribe records while held, stops on release and copies the completed transcript. Empty text or errors leave the clipboard unchanged.

Transkripttext kann bearbeitet, vollstän: Transcript text can be edited, copied fully or as a selection, and exported as TXT, SRT or VTT. TXT follows the timestamp setting. SRT and VTT use saved segment times. Compact joins segments into paragraphs without AI rewriting.
